GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.1 (25 Sep 45) MG
(SCAPIN-57)
APO 500
25 September 1945.
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Administration of Affairs in Southern Korea.
1. Your Memorandum CLO M No.13, dated 16 September 1945, concerning the administration of affairs in Korea south of 38 degrees North Latitude, is acknowledged.
2. Japanese nationals in the area involved are being treated and will continue to be treated in accordance with policies of the occupation. Their persons and religious beliefs are being respected and, consistent with military necessity, every effort is being made to accord them humane consideration.
3. As to the other matters covered by your Memorandum concerning food supply, transportation, communications and the operation of financial institutions, the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers will take such action as, in his absolute discretion, he deems appropriate.
4. A copy of your Memorandum has been transmitted to the Commanding General, United States Army Forces in Korea, for his information.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair,
/t/ HAROLD FAIR,
Lt. Col,A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
